zh.title: 波音執行長警告17,000名工程師罷工恐令777X認證停擺
zh.summary: 波音執行長警告若17,000名工程師罷工，777X認證恐停擺。
body: 波音（Boeing）執行長警告，若17,000名工程師罷工，777X的認證程序可能面臨停擺。這項訊息來自在2026年9月21日發布的一則報導。
報導指出，波音執行長警告，若17,000名工程師罷工，777X認證可能被推遲或中斷。該報導並未提供罷工是否已發生、實際影響或任何具體的認證進度細節。
報導標題將其稱為「最終關卡」（final hurdle），暗示777X認證已進入最後階段，但實際認證狀態、時間表或可能的影響均未被明確指出。
波音777X先前已獲美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）核准進行認證飛行測試，並預期在2027年進行首次交付。但這些細節來自歷史存檔紀錄，僅作為背景資料。

en.title: Boeing CEO warns 777X certification could be halted if 17,000 engineers strike
en.summary: Boeing CEO warns 777X certification could be halted if 17,000 engineers strike.
body: Boeing's chief executive has warned that certification of its 777X program could face a halt if 17,000 engineers go on strike. The warning was reported on September 21, 2026.

According to the report, the CEO warned, "If 17,000 engineers strike, the 777X could be halted at the final hurdle." The report does not specify when the strike might occur, whether it has already happened, or any specific certification milestones that would be affected.

The report describes the potential halt as happening at "the final hurdle" of the certification process. No further operational, technical, or schedule details were provided in the available evidence.
Previous records show the 777X received FAA approval for certification flight testing, with first delivery anticipated in 2027, but these are historical background and not part of the current claim.
